scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/backend && npm run build --workspace=packages/frontend

overrides.comment-uuid: exceljs@4.4.0 transitively pulls uuid@8.3.2 which has a buffer-bounds-check vuln (advisory: <11.1.1). The fix landed in uuid@11.1.1; we pin to ^11 across the tree until exceljs releases an update that ships a fixed uuid directly.
